faq: Does it work with older vintage themes?
App embeds work on any theme. App blocks need Online Store 2.0 themes with sections everywhere. For vintage themes we suggest an embed with a clear setup step.
Can the block show live data from my app?
Yes. We fetch data through an app proxy or store it in metafields, whichever suits your case. Both keep the storefront fast and avoid exposing keys in the browser.
Will it slow down the storefront?
We keep the scripts small, load them only where the block appears and defer anything heavy. The Premium package includes a speed check so you can see the effect.
Yes. Removing the block or turning off the embed leaves no code behind in the theme files, which is one of the main reasons to use theme app extensions.
